svg.text: Layers, components and data flow · numbers show the order of a run · dashed = human checkpoint or optional
tells the system a post went live
used when no topic is given
route input → call trend-captain → accept top trend → verify key facts → choose post type & format
→ write post (hook ≤140, context, beats, takeaway, CTA, first comment) → run checks → call review panel
→ deliver final post → save & index everything → offer publish options
paste-ready text + first comment + evidence + review summary
published only after your confirmation; URL saved
1 trigger 2 trend research 3 web evidence 4 hand-off to review 5–6 reviewers 7 save 8 deliver 9 publish (confirmed) · feedback: published posts feed the overlap check of the next run
